name: Season of the Burrow
description: Choose up to five {P} worth of modes. You may choose the same mode more than once. {P} -- Create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token. {P}{P} -- Exile target nonland permanent. Its controller draws a card. {P}{P}{P} -- Return target permanent card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield with an indestructible counter on it.
couldNotDerive: The Pawprint$ weighted point-buy mechanic (choose up to 5 pips worth, modes repeatable) -- read as a plain "choose one" instead.
notes: The three individual modes themselves reconstructed reasonably well (token/exile+draw/reanimate-with-counter), but SCHEMA's `combine` convention (choose exactly N of the following) has no representation for Forge's Pawprint$ mechanic (a point-buy system: choose up to 5 {P} worth of modes, weighted 1/2/3 pips each, repeatable) -- read by the examiner as a simple "choose one." A real, narrow modal-mechanic gap (Bloomburrow-specific), not attempted this round -- would need a genuine schema extension for weighted/repeatable modal choice, distinct from the existing fixed-N combine group.
